subject: [hw] DONE DEC04: measured DEC02 AU replay; 2116->1033 calls (-51%), N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2043/2043
body:
DONE DEC04. Host only: no phone, no publish, nothing outside gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/** and my STATUS.md edited.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
  SUMMARY 168 168 x3 (ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, TSan -O1)
  DEC04 IOCTLS per_au off=2116 on=1033 guest_stores=542 batches=542 max_stores_per_batch=1
  N2TEST V40 PASS 1539/1539   (V40 suite on the patched /tmp mirror)
  N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2043/2043
  ~35 s; artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-DEC04; tree header still rev 2, staged in the mirror only.

What changed since my 2016/2016 post (the production patch changed, V40 must re-check):
1. The oracle is now DEC02s MEASURED access unit, not a synthetic page replay. dec02_au1.inc = AU 1 of their 320x240 12-AU session, 1574 ops in recorded order (1032 R, 542 W), regenerated by vcu/test_dec04/tools/extract_dec02_trace.sh, which runs DEC02s own stage.py + n2tr in /tmp (unmodified) and adds only a per-AU MARK. The trace session totals (12767 R / 6886 W) equal PAGES.md exactly. mmio_bad=0.
2. Write-combining now also merges the flush into the next read: a guest read that arrives with stores queued sends [WRITE..., READ] as one RWVC_REGS batch and takes the value from it (vcu_wc_flush_read). Ordering is unchanged; it saves the separate flush ioctl.
3. Measured finding, important for DEC01/DEC05: DEC02s H.264 order contains NO two adjacent stores. Every one of the 542 stores is immediately preceded by a read of the same register (the vendors write helper is a read-modify-write), in all 12 AUs. So pure write-run batching has nothing to merge on this path (wc_max_batch=1). The 51% drop is one store carried by the following read plus not repeating the models own RMW read: 2116 -> 1033 calls per AU. The multi-store path is still implemented and tested synthetically (256-op cap, bursts, two threads); there is just no measured vendor burst yet. If a VENC/HEVC path does burst, it will merge.
Oracle checks: identical ordered write record (542), identical final register image of every window, identical 1032 guest read values, mmio_bad/gce_skipped 0 in both runs, every store (but the final start/stop trigger) shares its batch with the next read, off=2116/on=1033.

Deliverable files: vcu/test_dec04/{dec04.patch (vcu/n2vcu.c+h), dec04-v40-adapt.patch (vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c only), t_dec04.c, dec02_au1.inc, tools/extract_dec02_trace.sh, run_tests.sh, STATUS.md}, dsh-state/workers/DEC04/STATUS.md.

Not done / open:
- include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 not in the tree (opus-lead2 lands it after IP DONE). Patch uses RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, never a literal; compile-time assert 12/13.
- Default OFF is hw-v40s decision (board 1794418598), accepted; DEC01/DEC05 must call n2vcu_set_write_combining(v, 1) at open. Flag to disable = the setter.
- A failed batch loses its stores (guest store is void); counted in wc_errors.
- No phone run; no measured VENC/HEVC register trace; GCE still synchronous; no iOS link test of the model.
- V40 test adaptation must go in with rev 3 or their 0x1600100 expectation fails by design.

Staying available for review findings; will re-run and post DONE DEC04 rev N after the lead lands the header and V40 applies it.
